Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited to get Helium Health onboarded. To kick off legal review for the MSA + Order Form, attaching our current serving MSA (Redwood_MSA_v3.docx) and the blank Order Form template (OrderForm_Template.xlsx).

Quick asks so we can triage against your procurement process and speed the turnaround:
- Official contracting/legal entity name for Helium Health (including any parent company to appear on the signature block)
- Registered address and billing address (if different)
- Name and title of the person authorized to sign (and signer email)
- Any required PO / purchase order number format or procurement IDs
- Data residency or regulatory constraints (e.g., must-host-in-SG/EU) and whether you need a DPA/SOC2 attestation included in the MSA
- Any non-standard clauses you expect (e.g., indemnity caps, IP carve-outs, auditor access, or custom security controls)

If you can reply with a single spreadsheet (I included a stub file: helium-counterparty-details.xlsx) with the fields above, that will let our contracts team start an intake. Once we have those details we’ll aim to return an initial redline within 3 business days; if there are substantive commercial asks we’ll loop in GTM for alignment.

If you prefer a quick sync with Legal on the specifics, I can schedule a 30-minute slot tomorrow afternoon.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3.docx (template), OrderForm_Template.xlsx (template), helium-counterparty-details.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —

Hi Alex —

Thanks for sending these over. See answers inline and attached: I filled the spreadsheet (Helium_Counterparty_20260616.xlsx) with our entity and billing details. Summary below:

- Legal entity: Helium Health Ltd (registered in SG), parent: Helium Global Pte Ltd
- Registered address: 12 Orchard Road, #08-02, Singapore 238857
- Billing address: Same as above
- Authorized signer: Mr. Arun Pillai, COO <arun.pillai@heliumhealth.com>
- PO: we will raise a PO once pricing finalized; PO format is HH-YYYY-XXXXX
- Data residency: We prefer data to be stored in Singapore or EU. We cannot accept US-only hosting for PHI-equivalent data.
- Required attestation: SOC 2 Type II report within 30 days of contract execution (we usually get copies via secure link)
- A couple of commercial asks: liability cap at 3x fees for the first 12 months and a 45-day SLA for critical incident response (we can iterate on exact wording)

I’ve attached our procurement intake form as well (Procurement_Form_Helium_20260616.pdf) with a few checklist items. One question: do you have a standard DPA you attach, or should we propose our DPA redlines?

Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow 10:30 SGT if that helps (I’m GMT+8).

Regards,
Priya Nair

p.nair@heliumhealth.com
